$comment: Controlled theme vocabulary for the FAITH domain (hard-partitioned; never mixed with the business vocab in vocab/themes.json). Centered on the library's Latter-day Saint titles (Callister, Bednar, Dew, Nelson, Holland, Madsen, Bushman, Saints) but written to also fit the broader Christian/interfaith titles (Paul: A Biography, Seeking Allah Finding Jesus, Tattoos on the Heart, The Ruthless Elimination of Hurry). LDS-specific themes simply go untagged on non-LDS books. Tag books in this domain with `commonplace tag --vocab faith`.

$glosses.atonement_grace: the Atonement of Jesus Christ, grace, mercy, redemption, being saved
$glosses.revelation_prophecy: divine revelation, prophecy, prophets and apostles, inspired guidance to the church
$glosses.covenants_ordinances: covenants, baptism, sacrament, temple ordinances, sacred promises with God
$glosses.priesthood: priesthood authority, keys, offices, and priesthood blessings
$glosses.plan_of_salvation: premortal life, purpose of mortality, resurrection, eternal life and exaltation
$glosses.restoration: the Restoration, apostasy, Joseph Smith, and the coming forth of scripture
$glosses.faith_and_belief: faith in Jesus Christ, belief, trust and reliance on God
$glosses.repentance: repentance, forsaking sin, change of heart, becoming better
$glosses.obedience: obedience to commandments, agency and choice, keeping covenants
$glosses.conversion_testimony: spiritual conversion, gaining a testimony, coming unto Christ
$glosses.prayer: prayer, communing with God, seeking and receiving answers
$glosses.scripture_study: studying scripture — Bible, Book of Mormon, the word of God
$glosses.temple_and_sabbath: temple worship, the Sabbath, sacred time and reverence
$glosses.charity_and_love: charity, the love of God, loving one's neighbor, compassion
$glosses.service_and_ministering: service, ministering to others, lifting and consecrating
$glosses.humility: humility, meekness, submitting one's will to God
$glosses.forgiveness: forgiving others, reconciliation, releasing offense and resentment
$glosses.family_and_marriage: family, marriage, home, and eternal family relationships
$glosses.teaching_and_parenting: teaching the gospel, raising children, mentoring in faith
$glosses.church_history: history of the church, pioneers, and events of the Restoration
$glosses.missionary_work: sharing the gospel, missionary service, gathering others
$glosses.callings_and_leadership: serving in callings, leading and shepherding in the church
$glosses.adversity_and_endurance: trials, suffering, patience, and enduring to the end
$glosses.hope_and_peace: hope, comfort, peace, and rest in Christ amid a hurried world
$glosses.personal_growth: spiritual growth, discipline, becoming, and Christlike character
